# zjs

> zjs is an embeddable JavaScript engine written in Zig and a semantic and
> mechanism-level rewrite of Bellard QuickJS. It runs JavaScript inside trusted
> Zig applications through a Zig-native API with explicit runtime, context,
> value, and ownership lifetimes.

Canonical source: https://github.com/aneryu/zjs

zjs is not Node.js, Deno, Bun, a browser, a hostile-code sandbox, or a drop-in
replacement for the libquickjs C API. TypeScript syntax erasure is partial; zjs
is not a TypeScript type checker or a replacement for tsc.

## Start Here

- [Project overview](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/README.md): identity, use cases, build instructions, embedding example, and roadmap.
- [Current status](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/STATUS.md): authoritative checked status and validation snapshots.
- [Embedding cookbook](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/embedding-cookbook.md): runtime, context, values, host functions, limits, modules, and plugins.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/COMPATIBILITY.md): test262 profile, supported features, and explicit exclusions.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/LIMITATIONS.md): product boundaries and unsupported capabilities.

- [Public API contract](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/public-api-contract.md): supported Zig API surface and ownership rules.

- [Security boundary](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/security-boundary.md): trusted-code assumptions and reliability controls.
- [Performance vs QuickJS](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/perf/zoo-status.md): current measured comparison, provenance, and caveats.
- [Documentation map](https://github.com/aneryu/zjs/blob/main/docs/README.md): index of active project documentation.
